caption:
Mountain biking in Costa Rica is often a conversation between your lungs and the incline. When the road turns to gravel and the forest closes in, the technical noise of the city disappears, leaving only the rhythm of your own breath against the weight of the climb. It is a quiet, singular pursuit where the only thing that matters is the next rotation of the pedals.
